d: Platinum white hair, long and flowing with straight bangs, featuring a single small streak of deep crimson on the left side and a small gathered ponytail on the right. One eye is wide and bright sky blue, while the other is winkingly closed, set upon a youthful face with an adolescent maturity. The build is slender, dressed in a black oversized tactical jacket with a glossy finish, layered over a black shirt with white graphic lettering and accented by neon pink straps and silver metallic buckles. A massive black and neon pink futuristic railgun is slung over the shoulder, held by a grey industrial strap.
